resources.name: ApolloStorage API
resources.description:
GCS-inspired, event-sourced object store.

HTTP surface on {{ _.base_url }} (health, metrics, admin blob-gc) — these run in the Collection Runner. gRPC ObjectApi on {{ _.grpc_url }} uses the embedded object_api.proto (the Collection Runner does not drive gRPC; use these requests manually).

Auth is off by default. To exercise it, set AUTH_ENABLED=true on the server, put a token in the `auth_token` environment variable, and enable the Bearer auth / gRPC `authorization` metadata on the write requests.

resources.name: object_api.proto
HTTP (runnable)
resources.description: Health, metrics, and the admin blob-GC sweep. Safe to run top-to-bottom in the Collection Runner.

resources.name: gRPC — ObjectApi
resources.description: Object lifecycle over gRPC (h2c on port 8443). Not driven by the Collection Runner — send these manually.

resources.name: Health
resources.description: Liveness/readiness probe. 200 {"status":"UP"} while serving; 503 DOWN during shutdown.

resources.name: Metrics (Prometheus)
resources.description: Prometheus text exposition. Unauthenticated (operational telemetry only). 404 if metrics are disabled.

resources.name: Blob GC — dry run
resources.description: Reconciliation sweep, REPORT ONLY (nothing deleted). 404 unless blob-gc is enabled; 401/403 when auth is on and the token is missing/read-scoped.

resources.name: Blob GC — delete (destructive)
resources.description: DESTRUCTIVE: reclaims aged orphan blobs + stale .tmp debris. Requires a WRITE-scoped token when auth is on.

parameters.name: delete
parameters.description: Set true to actually delete; omit/false for a dry run.

resources.name: REST object API (/v1)
resources.description: The plain RESTful bucket/object API. Same event-sourced core as gRPC — shared generations, checksums and effects. Bearer token required for every operation when auth is enabled (write scope for mutations).

resources.name: List buckets
resources.description: Paginated bucket listing from the read model. Optional pageSize / pageToken.

resources.name: Create bucket
resources.description: Creates the bucket. 201 on success, 409 if it already exists. Write scope.

resources.name: Delete bucket
resources.description: Deletes an EMPTY bucket. 204 on success, 404 if missing. Write scope. Destructive.

resources.name: List objects
resources.description: Objects in the bucket, served from the read model — EVENTUALLY CONSISTENT, so a fresh upload may take a moment to appear. Optional prefix / pageSize / pageToken.

resources.name: Upload object
resources.description: Streams the RAW request body as the object payload (not multipart). Responds 201 with the X-Apollo-* metadata headers. Optionally send X-Apollo-Crc32c AND X-Apollo-Md5 to have the server enforce an expected checksum (412 on mismatch). Swap this body to 'File' to upload a real file.

resources.name: Download object
resources.description: Streams the object bytes back, with the X-Apollo-* metadata headers. 404 if absent. Responses carry an ETag; enable the If-None-Match header and paste it back to revalidate cheaply.

headers.name: If-None-Match
headers.description: Paste the ETag from a previous response to revalidate: a match returns 304 with no body, resolved from metadata without reading the payload.

resources.name: Head object (metadata only)
resources.description: Metadata as X-Apollo-* headers with no body — generation, size, crc32c, md5.

resources.name: Delete object
resources.description: Deletes the object. 204 on success, 404 if absent. Write scope. Destructive.
